thread:
Maya: Morning triage — quick status check. Queue: 54 open, 3 flagged P0 (SSO login failures, payment duplicate), ~8 P1. Known issues: SSO returning 500s intermittently (auth-service). Payment webhook duplicates for some Stripe events. Macros: 'sso-login-steps' needs the new log path + TL;DR; 'payment-duplicate' needs clear troubleshooting steps. Assignments: Alex on SSO, Priya on payment. Can someone pick up macro edits? Any blockers?

Alex: I'm on SSO. Repro on staging with tenant 42. Seeing auth-service 500s tied to cache miss + DB timeout. Working on a fix, will open a PR in ~30m. Short-term workaround: restart auth cache pod: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-service -n prod` — reduces error rate for ~10m. @Maya want me to run it?

Maya: please go ahead and run the restart and post counts after. If we see improvement I'll update the status page. Thanks.

Priya: payment duplicates — root cause looks like retry logic creating a charge when idempotency_key is missing. Draft macro below, will push to /macros/payments for review. Snippet:
```
If a customer reports a duplicate charge:
1) ask for timestamp + charge ID
2) check Stripe dashboard for idempotency_key
3) run: SELECT * FROM charges WHERE stripe_id = <id>
4) if duplicate, refund and escalate to payments-eng
```
I'll add exact SQL and a link to the dashboard.

Sam: queue breakdown by product: embeddings 28, chat 10, ingest 8. Most embeddings are big bulk jobs — we should remind customers to batch. Could be a macro bullet: "suggest batching ~500 items per job".

Priya: noted, I'll add batching suggestion to the payments/ingest macros where relevant.

ops-bot: Incident template applied to #statuspage: "SSO degraded" — status: investigating.

Maya: volunteers for macro edits? @Priya will draft payments; @Alex will add SSO steps. Can someone do TL;DRs and escalation lines? @Jordan?

Jordan: I can handle TL;DRs and escalation language after Alex and Priya finish. Suggest adding: "When to page eng-sre: >10% error rate sustained for 5m or any data loss".

Alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.corp/p/sso-fix/pull/123 — preparing to roll in ~15m. Will post before/after counts.

Maya: great. After patch post error counts. If errors drop below 5% I'll close the P0.

Jordan: added escalation note to macro draft: "If >10% failed tokens across 5m, page eng-sre and include /metrics/sso-errors link."

Sam: :thumbsup:

Maya: wrapping up this check-in — I'll re-run queue scan at 10:30 and post final counts. Thanks everyone.
